positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer for RedRocksSocial, an iOS app.

Responsible for the backend development of the app - developing Python scripts to query social media sites (Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, etc), process the data that we get from the social media sites, and store it in a database.

positions.title: Chemical Engineer
positions.description:
Process Engineer in Emulsions and Antifoams.

Process Improvement/Manufacturing Support - Defect rate reduction of 127,000 ppm to <0.01 ppm in one of DCC’s highest volume emulsions.

Six Sigma Activities - $200,000 in savings of purchased surfactants by qualifying new sources and negotiating lower prices with existing suppliers.

Process Development - Discovered a new manufacturing process for a specific type of emulsion that resulted in a 75% reduction in processing costs and a 10 times larger batch size.

Product Development - Led the emulsion product development efforts for a new product launch.  Selected and optimized the formulation, processing, product clarity, and stability.

New Product Commercialization - Succeeded in an aggressive effort to take a new emulsion from development to manufacturing in 8 weeks.  Resulted in $400,000/yr of new product sales.
